mainEntity.name: Should I manage the renovation myself or hire a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor is often recommended for investment property renovations, especially for larger or more complex projects. A general contractor oversees all aspects, including hiring subcontractors, managing schedules, obtaining permits, and ensuring quality and compliance. While self-managing might save money on labor, it requires significant time, expertise, and a network of reliable tradespeople. For investors, delegating to a professional general contractor can ensure a smoother process, timely completion, and adherence to budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: For most investment property renovations, hiring a general contractor is recommended to manage the project, subcontractors, and timelines, ensuring quality and compliance.
